name: Bennett's tree-kangaroo
desc: Eats leaves of dozens of rainforest plants, especially umbrella tree, in a small range north of Cooktown.
about: Bennett's tree-kangaroo is a large tree-kangaroo. Males can weigh from 11.5 kg up to almost 14 kg (25 to 31 lbs), while the females range between about 8 to 10.6 kg (18 to 23 lb).
